question: Draft a short submission paragraph on whether section 6 of the Kenya Information and Communications Act (the Board of the Authority) is still good law.
notes: Okiya Omtatah v AG (2020) HC declared s.6 unconstitutional; status: declared unconstitutional.

question: Draft a paragraph for written submissions on whether a client can still be charged with subversive activities under section 77 of the Penal Code.
notes: Katiba Institute & 8 others v DPP (2024) HC declared s.77 unconstitutional; status: declared unconstitutional.

question: Draft a short paragraph on the constitutional position of section 11 of the Sexual Offences Act (indecent act).
notes: CKW v AG (2014) upheld; Wachira & 12 others v Republic (2022) declared unconstitutional in part; status: limited by a court.

question: Draft a paragraph explaining the current position on mandatory minimum sentences for defilement under section 8 of the Sexual Offences Act.
column9: Ayako) reversed by the Supreme Court (2024-2025); status: in force; earlier court limits were reversed.

question: Draft a submission paragraph on whether the death sentence for robbery with violence under section 296(2) of the Penal Code is still mandatory.
notes: Kahinga (2016) HC declared it unconstitutional in part; Muruatetu directions (2021) confine Muruatetu to murder; Kittiny and others displaced; status: limited by a court.

question: Draft a paragraph summarising what the High Court decided in Mbuti & 5 others v Attorney General about the security for keeping the peace provisions of the Criminal Procedure Code.
notes: Mbuti (2015) declared CPC ss.43-61A unconstitutional; status: declared unconstitutional.

question: Draft a paragraph on what the CORD v Republic (2015) security laws case decided about section 20A of the Evidence Act.
notes: CORD v Republic (2015) HC declared Evidence Act s.20A unconstitutional; status: declared unconstitutional.

question: Draft a submission on arrest without a warrant under section 21 of the Criminal Procedure Code citing Wekesa v Nairobi Bottlers Ltd (2019).
notes: Katiba Institute v AG (2022) read down s.21; status: limited by a court. Wekesa v Nairobi Bottlers has no title match: the draft should say it can't be confirmed (not_confirmed if dropped silently).

question: Draft a paragraph on whether section 107 of the Land Registration Act has been struck down by any court.
notes: Hakiki does not hold the Land Registration Act; the draft says so and invents no rulings.

question: Draft a paragraph on how courts have interpreted the general punishment for theft under section 275 of the Penal Code.
notes: Kwaka & another v Republic (2022) HC interpreted s.275; status: in force; interpreted by a court.
